title: Ready Concepts Finder
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Select exactly the ready concepts in a 16-concept learning graph for six different sets of mastered concepts.

educational.topic: Finding ready concepts in a learning graph
learningObjectives: The learner will solve six problems by selecting exactly the set of ready concepts in a 16-concept learning graph for a given set of mastered concepts, correctly answering at least five of six on the first attempt.
prerequisites: Learning dependency, foundational concept, directed acyclic graph, learning path, and the ready rule, from the section "Learning Graphs: Maps of Concepts" in Chapter 9.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Apply a rule node by node on a graph, with the evidence highlighted after each answer
keyQuestions: Are all of its direct prerequisites mastered?
commonMisconceptions: A concept is ready as soon as one prerequisite is mastered
A concept already mastered can still be ready
Only one concept can be ready at a time
assessmentOpportunities: Nothing is mastered. Which concepts are ready?
Can a mastered concept be ready?
Long-Running Task needs Task Horizon and AI Agent. Only AI Agent is mastered. Is it ready?
Can more than one concept be ready at once?

controls.name: Concepts in the graph
controls.description: click to pick or unpick a concept and see its prerequisites. Mastered concepts cannot be picked.

controls.name: Submit
controls.description: commits your set. Two attempts per problem; only the first counts.

controls.name: Next
controls.description: moves on; after problem 6 it shows your score.
